Thanks Jenna — quick technical notes from my side:

- We’ve seen an issue where tenant-selection prompts trigger a session swap when a vendor account has a pre-existing shadow identity tied to another subsidiary tenant. That can leave the Accept button in a disabled state because the client-side check fails (the page thinks the vendor is already bound but the backend hasn’t finished creating the entity).
- Short term: try an incognito window and clear site cookies for the portal domain. If that doesn’t work, have the vendor paste the entire redirect URL after clicking Accept (we can decode query params to see which tenant id was picked).
- I’ve attached a trimmed console capture template (console-logs.txt) you can ask them to fill out. Also here’s a private runbook for manual activation if you want us to flip the flag server-side: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3c-runbook (internal access).

If you prefer we can do manual activation: we need the vendor email, company name, and a matching DUNS/TaxID to avoid duplicate profiles. If you send those I can create a temporary activation token that bypasses the web accept flow (valid for 24 hours).

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Onboarding Specialist — Redwood Inference
